mapper.sql: select id, biz_type, file_name, file_path, query_params, status, row_count, err_msg, creator_id, creator_name, create_time, start_time, finish_time, expire_time, deleted from crm_export_task
mapper.insert: insert into crm_export_task ( biz_type, file_name, query_params, status, row_count, creator_id, creator_name, create_time, expire_time, deleted ) values ( #{bizType}, #{fileName}, #{queryParams}, #{status}, 0, #{creatorId}, #{creatorName}, #{createTime}, #{expireTime}, 0 )
mapper.update: update crm_export_task set status = 1, start_time = #{startTime}, err_msg = null where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
update crm_export_task set status = 2, file_path = #{filePath}, row_count = #{rowCount}, finish_time = #{finishTime}, err_msg = null where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
mapper.select: select id, file_path from crm_export_task where deleted = 0 and expire_time is not null and expire_time < #{expireBefore} order by expire_time limit #{limit}
